### Your Task:

1. Visit the following pages and extract ALL image URLs:
   - https://www.odinsinnovations.com/ (homepage - look for hero images, banners)
   - https://www.odinsinnovations.com/collections/scent-beads (collection page)
   - https://www.odinsinnovations.com/products/doe-estrus-scent-beads (product page)
   
2. Look for video content:
   - Check for any video files, embeds, or links
   - Look for .mp4, .webm, YouTube embeds, Vimeo, etc.
   
3. Categorize images by type:
   - Product images (bottles, packaging)
   - Hero/banner images
   - Logo/symbol images
   - Lifestyle/action shots (deer, hunting scenes)
   - Icons/graphics
   
4. Download all assets to:
   - /sites/odins-innovations/doe-estrus-guide/public/images/
   - /sites/odins-innovations/doe-estrus-guide/public/videos/ (if any)

5. Create a manifest file listing all downloaded assets with their source URLs

### Target Assets Needed for Microsite:

**Hero Section:**
- Large hero image for doe estrus page
- Background video (if available)

**Products:**
- Doe Estrus Scent Beads bottle image
- Liquid scent bottle image
- Season Kit image

**Icons/Trust Badges:**
- Made in USA icon
- Waterproof/weatherproof icon
- CWD-safe icon
- Biodegradable icon

**Brand:**
- Logo (symbol and wordmark)

### Output:

Return a complete list of:
1. All image URLs found (organized by page and category)
2. Any video URLs found
3. Confirmation of which files were downloaded
4. The manifest file content

Note: The CDN URLs are from Shopify CDN (cdn.shopify.com)
